tasks.subject: Copy input.txt to output.txt byte-for-byte and verify identity
tasks.description:
Project directory (this is the ONLY directory you may operate in; use full absolute paths):
/tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace

Goal:
1) Read /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/input.txt
2) Write its content EXACTLY as-is (byte-for-byte, no newline changes, no encoding changes, no trimming) to /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/output.txt
3) Actually verify byte identity on disk, e.g.:
   cmp /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/input.txt /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/output.txt
   shasum -a 256 /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/input.txt /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/output.txt
   wc -c on both files
   Record the real exit codes and hash values.
4) Write a JSON report to /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace/reports/worker-report.json containing: task id, status, the file paths as PROJECT-RELATIVE paths (input.txt, output.txt, reports/worker-report.json - NOT absolute paths), byte sizes, sha256 hashes of both files, the exact commands run and their exit codes, and a boolean byteIdentical.
5) Claim the task, then complete it with an output summary that includes the observed byte sizes, the sha256 hashes, and the byteIdentical result.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT read, write, or list anything outside /tmp/agentteams-final-validation/renamed/run/candidate/workspace.
- Do NOT read any plugin configuration or AgentTeams state files; do not touch .agent-teams.
- In all report content, path fields must stay project-relative.
- If verification fails for any reason, report the failure honestly with real command output instead of claiming success.

Report written to project-relative reports/worker-report.json (valid JSON, status=completed, byteIdentical=true, all path fields project-relative).
